method: Three alternating frozen CPU0 release processes; repeated build/drop means and cold/constructor/max 4096-byte worker slice observations separate. RSS/CPU/scheduler counters retained. Same-semantics scalar scan and wide map controls. No concurrent builds/tests/owned GUI or source mutations.

result.method: Mean full build/drop, retained-style three-property lookup mean, cold first calls and maximum observed 128-node worker step. Literal generated scalars verified outside timings. Shared allocations counted once; Arc controls included; allocator/hash controls and borrowed DOM/rules excluded. Tree container capacities included. Not process RSS.
result.scope: Original document style jobs from prebuilt HTML/RuleSet/Defaults; inline declaration parsing included. Supplied fixed numeric font/palette context, no font selection/shaping, UA sheet, layout, rasterization, JS/network/UI/website/Chrome evidence.
